## 5. Full anomaly checklist (questioned-documents and forensic-accounting practice)

Key: **Scan** = testable on the phone scan; **Orig** = needs the originals or stubs. "Def. Exh. 5 result" applies the test to the 110 collection receipts using the CSV and the scan review. FOUND = present on the face. NOT FOUND = tested on the scan and absent. NEEDS ORIGINAL = cannot be tested on the scan.

| # | Anomaly type | What it may indicate | Test (scan / original) | Def. Exh. 5 result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Serial order against date order | Entries not made when dated; back-filling | Scan: sort by serial, compare dates | **FOUND.** At least 6 reversals (0122/0121; 0132 vs 0124–0130; 0130/0129; 0220/0219/0218; 0227/0226) |
| 2 | Near-consecutive serials over long periods | A booklet kept for one payor, or batch writing | Scan: serial gap per day gap | **FOUND.** 0128→0129 = 500 days; 0132→0133 = 510 days; 0106–0136 = 31 numbers in 34 months |
| 3 | Sudden serial jump | Other booklets or issues in between; missing stubs | Scan; Orig: stubs | **FOUND.** 0136 (21 May 2016) → 0217 (Aug 2016): 81 numbers in about 11 weeks |
| 4 | Two receipts the same day, far apart in serial | Non-sequential use; later insertion | Scan | **FOUND.** 0019 and 0061, both 28 Mar 2007 |
| 5 | Missing stubs or duplicates | Suppression; the gap cannot be explained | Orig only | **NEEDS ORIGINAL.** Gaps: 0001–0018, 0020–0060, 0137–0216, etc. |
| 6 | Form or printer version against date (ATP date and expiry) | Form used outside its valid period; anachronism | Scan: imprint; BIR records | **FOUND.** Imprint "Auth. No. 451-1998 / RD64-016-99 / 4C's Press". Under RR 18-2012 §5, pre-2012 stock was valid only to **30 Jun 2013**. 34 receipts dated 31 Jul 2013 – Feb 2017 are on this stock. BIR confirmation [VERIFY] |
| 7 | Receipt dated before the booklet was printed | Fabrication | Scan: compare date with imprint year; Orig: paper | **NOT FOUND.** Earliest estate form is 2007; the imprint says 1998 |
| 8 | TIN, name or address on the form against the issuer of record | Form not the issuer's; wrong entity | Scan; BIR | **FOUND [VERIFY].** Form TIN 160-902-582 against Cesar's TIN 160-901-502 on the 2017 confirmation. Registrant unknown |
| 9 | VAT / non-VAT wording, peso-sign style, layout against the rules of the period | Form not compliant for the period | Scan | **FOUND, partly.** Prints "Non Vat" and "Official Receipt". Generic forms (A–H) carry no name, TIN or serial: unregistered stationery |
| 10 | Dated on Sundays or holidays | Out-of-pattern dating (weak for private collection) | Scan: calendar check | **FOUND, low value.** 14 of 111 on Sundays (about the expected one-in-seven); 8 on holiday-type dates (e.g. 9 Apr 2005, 30 Nov 2005/2008/2013, 31 Dec 2009/2013, 1 May 2007). Not useful unless the collector's routine is shown |
| 11 | Impossible dates (e.g. 31 Apr), month-only dates | Careless back-filling | Scan | **FOUND.** "April 31, 2010"; month-only Nos. 0062–0063 |
| 12 | Corrections, erasures, overwriting | Alteration (Rule 132 §31) | Scan, partly; Orig: magnification and UV | **FOUND.** "August" struck on 31 Jul 2009; year of No. 0104 overwritten. More may need originals |
| 13 | Amount in words against figures | Alteration or careless writing | Scan | **NOT FOUND.** Words and figures match on all legible receipts |
| 14 | Round-number pattern | Estimates, not real transactions (weak; rent is naturally round) | Scan | **FOUND, low value.** 106 of 110 are multiples of ₱1,000 |
| 15 | Month-end clustering | Bulk dating to month ends | Scan | **FOUND, moderate.** 64 of 111 dated the 28th or later. Consistent with monthly rent, or with batch dating |
| 16 | Totals against the price or installment plan | Mixing rent and price; overpayment shows a mixed purpose | Scan: totals | **FOUND.** ₱602,950 total against ₱250,000 price; ₱219,000 after the deed |
| 17 | Receipts after the deed's "in hand paid" recital | Recital false, or receipts not tied to the price | Scan | **FOUND.** 9 receipts, Sep 2016 – Feb 2017; "Full payment" No. 0228 |
| 18 | Receipts after the payee's or agent's death; or after revocation | Collection without authority | Scan plus death and revocation dates | **After death: NOT FOUND.** Last receipt Feb 2017; Cesar's death recorded 21 Jun 2017 [VERIFY PSA]. **After the 15 Aug 2005 revocation: FOUND.** About 100 receipts |
| 19 | No collector name or authority | Unauthorized collector (Art. 1240) | Scan | **FOUND.** "Authorized Collector" printed with no name; no receipt names Cesar |
| 20 | Body handwriting differs from the signature hand | A different person wrote the body | Scan (indicative); Orig | **NEEDS ORIGINAL.** Not systematically logged on the scan |
| 21 | Signature too uniform across years | Simulation or tracing indicators: tremor, blunt starts, pen lifts (neutral description) | Scan (shape); Orig: stereo-microscope | **FOUND as a question.** "S" form looks the same 2004–2017 on the scan. Line quality needs originals |
| 22 | Two signature forms for one collector | More than one signer | Scan | **FOUND.** "V" (2003–05) and "S" (2004–17) overlap in Nov–Dec 2004 |
| 23 | Same ink across receipts years apart | Writing in one sitting | Scan (colour only, unreliable); Orig: VSC, TLC | **NEEDS ORIGINAL.** Scan colour groups shift by period (blue → red → violet → black), but colour on a scan is not proof |
| 24 | Ink colour change within one receipt | Later addition | Scan (weak); Orig: VSC | **NEEDS ORIGINAL** |
| 25 | Uniform pen pressure or indented impressions from writing on top | Receipts written stacked or in sequence | Orig only (ESDA/side-light) | **NEEDS ORIGINAL** |
| 26 | Carbon or duplicate does not match the original | Original rewritten after issue | Orig plus duplicates | **NEEDS ORIGINAL** (duplicates not produced) |
| 27 | Paper aging inconsistent across dates (toning, brittleness, fluorescence) | Recent writing on old stock, or vice versa | Orig: UV | **NEEDS ORIGINAL** |
| 28 | Payor name variations | Different writers or sittings; identity questions | Scan | **FOUND.** "Golly/Mrs. Golly/Mrs Golly", "Gloria/Gloria H./Mrs. Gloria", "Princess/PRINCES", case shifts in "EFREN BALANE". Mostly ordinary variation; "Golly" = Gloria [INFERRED] |
| 29 | Purpose wording shifts (rent / down payment / full payment) | Recharacterization after the fact | Scan | **FOUND.** "Down payment" in Jan 2005, 15 months after the first receipt; "Payment for the month of" on estate forms; "Full payment" in the month field |
| 30 | Notes outside the form fields | Later annotation | Scan; Orig ink | **FOUND.** "Start 10k-" (27 Jun 2009); "(For May 2014)" |
| 31 | Gaps in a periodic series | Missing receipts, or non-payment | Scan | **FOUND.** All of 2015; Feb 2012 – Jun 2013; others |
| 32 | Only one payor in a multi-occupant series | Booklet kept for the litigation | Scan plus record search; Orig stubs | **FOUND [INFERRED].** All 110 receipts are to Balanes; no other payor in the record |
| 33 | Receipts not remitted or not recorded in the principal's books | Collection never reached the creditor (Art. 1241) | Remittance records; Patricia | **NEEDS RECORDS.** No remittance evidence in the file |
| 34 | Printer's records (job order, delivery date, booklet count) against the use dates | Booklets printed later than claimed | Subpoena to 4C's Press; BIR printer reports | **NEEDS RECORDS** |
